assessment: This manuscript characterizes differences in replicative lifespan across a collection of natural yeast isolates. Additionally, it provides transcriptional and metabolomic resources that help shed important new light on the mechanistic bases of functional differences among the wild yeast isolates. The revised version further tests the impact on lifespan in short- and long-lived strains of target genes identified. This work has important implications for the fields biology of aging and potentially evolutionary biology.
